subject: SIG: Offline update & media handoff procedures for on‑prem deployments
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme-corp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@unihealth.org>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow up — air‑gapped update process and media handoff

Hannah,

Thanks for walking through the SIG during our call this morning. A couple of items Acme's security team asked us to confirm in writing: the mechanics for delivering offline updates to an on‑prem deployment, chain‑of‑custody for physical media shipments, and the support model if an update fails in an air‑gapped environment.

Could you provide a concrete runbook or addendum we can attach to the SIG? Ideally it should include:
- Typical cadence for offline update bundles and what’s included (patches, manifests, checksums)
- Packaging and encryption expectations for transport media (e.g., encrypted disk, signed manifest)
- Recommended carrier/hand‑off checklist and verification steps on receipt
- Support SLAs for retry/rollback and options for escorted delivery

We are starting our internal review next Tuesday. If possible, please send a draft addendum we can circulate to our auditors.

Best,
Elena
Security Program Manager, Acme Corp

[attachment: SIG_questionnaire_responses.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG follow up — air‑gapped update process and media handoff

Marcus/Laura — forwarding Acme’s ask. They want a concise addendum to the SIG that documents the offline update procedure and the media handoff/checklist. I sketched something during the call; attaching my notes. Can we take point on this and produce a customer‑friendly addendum and a separate internal runbook (ops playbook) for our engineers?

High level proposal:
- Customer‑facing addendum (PDF, 1–2 pages): what we provide, what the customer is responsible for, checklist at receipt
- Internal ops playbook (private): step‑by‑step for packaging, encryption, manifest signing, test/rollback, and evidence collection

Timeline: draft to Elena by EOD Wednesday (2027‑03‑24) to let them review before next Tuesday.

Hannah
Director, Customer Security (on behalf of Compliance Team)
Redwood Inference

[attachment: h_schmitt_notes_onprem_updates.txt]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG follow up — air‑gapped update process and media handoff

Acknowledged. Laura and I will draft the customer addendum and the internal ops playbook. A few operational notes to include in the ops playbook:
- All offline bundles will be built from the release pipeline with reproducible artifact IDs and PGP‑signed manifests.
- Media will be encrypted with customer‑provided public key (preferred) or Redwood KMS export key when requested; we will provide verification instructions post‑receipt.
- Chain‑of‑custody: packing list, carrier tracking, and signature confirmation. For high‑risk customers we recommend escorted transfer and shared custody (two signatures).
- Rollback: a tested rollback snapshot will be included in the bundle; support tier will be required for onsite rollback assistance.

Will circulate a first pass by Tuesday morning for review.

Marcus
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference

> On Mon, Mar 22, 2027 at 11:03 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Marcus/Laura — forwarding Acme’s ask. They want a concise addendum to the SIG...

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme-corp.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft: On‑Prem Offline Update & Media Handoff Addendum (for SIG)

Elena/Jamal — please find attached a customer‑facing draft addendum that covers the items you requested. Key points:
- What Redwood provides: release bundle contents, PGP‑signed manifest, verification steps, recommended carriers.
- Customer responsibilities: receipt verification, private key handling for decryption (if using customer key), secure storage of media upon arrival.
- Delivery options: standard courier (signature + tracking), escorted transfer (pre‑arranged), or encrypted package delivered to a designated secure facility.
- Support model: 24x7 phone escalation for Dedicated customers; standard business hours for self‑serve customers (with paid on‑call add‑ons); the addendum lists estimated timelines for remote assistance, remote rollback prep, and on‑site dispatch windows.

A few open questions noted in the draft:
1) Do we include a template chain‑of‑custody manifest (yes/no)?
2) If customer requests Redwood‑managed KMS export, what extra legal/contract terms are needed?
3) How granular should the SLA windows be for escorted delivery vs remote assist?

If this aligns with Acme's expectations I can send a PDF they can circulate to their auditors. Marcus — internal ops playbook will be a separate doc; we referenced it in the addendum.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference

[attachment: SIG_onprem_media_handoff_draft_v1.pdf]

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@acme-corp.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@unihealth.org>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: On‑Prem Offline Update & Media Handoff Addendum (for SIG)

Laura — this is exactly what we needed, thank you. A couple quick clarifications from our auditors:
- Please attach a sample chain‑of‑custody manifest (CSV) so they can see the fields we will receive.
- In the KMS export scenario, auditors want language that explicitly states Redwood will not retain customer decryption keys after handoff unless a contract addendum is signed.
- For escorted deliveries we will require two authorized signers on both ends; can Redwood provide a redacted example of the escorted delivery acceptance form?

If you can add the manifest sample and the key retention language we can mark this as accepted for the SIG addendum.

Best regards,
Elena

Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: SIG addendum + manifest (attached) — next steps

Elena — thanks for the confirmation and the clarifying asks. Attached are: the customer‑facing PDF addendum (final), a sample chain‑of‑custody CSV manifest, and a redacted escorted delivery acceptance form. We also added explicit language stating Redwood will not retain customer decryption keys post‑handoff unless a signed addendum is in place.

Next steps:
- Elena: circulate to auditors; let us know if they require any additional redactions or contractual language.
- Acme: sign the addendum (DocuSign link included above) or propose modifications.
- Redwood: Marcus will produce the internal ops playbook and checklist and file it under the internal compliance repo.

If there are time‑sensitive escort requests please include us on the logistics thread so we can coordinate scheduling.

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
